parties.respondent: M/S Steel Authority of India & Anr Etc.

summary: The nine-Judge Bench overruled India Cement Ltd. v. State of Tamil Nadu, which had invalidated certain state levies under Entries 49 and 50 of List II of the Seventh Schedule. Submissions were heard on whether the overruling should have prospective effect due to reliance on the prior precedent by states, businesses, and consumers. The Court examined the doctrine of prospective overruling, its application in Indian and US jurisprudence, and balanced public interest, commercial certainty, and fiscal impact. The judgment addressed concerns of retrospective tax liability, disruption of mineral auctions, and inequitable fiscal outcomes.
legal_provisions_cited: Golak Nath v. State of Punjab
India Cement Ltd. v. State of Tamil Nadu
Great Northern Railway Co. v. Sunburst Oil and Refining Co.
State of West Bengal v. Kesoram Industries Ltd.
final_judgment: The Court reserved the decision on the prospective application of the overruling, indicating it would consider the principles of justice, equity, and public interest before final determination.
